template: Equity OBV divergence on SPY with 5-day confirmation
prompt: Implement the desk's OBV divergence reference on SPY. Window: 2022-01-01 to 2024-12-31. Capital: 100,000. Resolution: minute. Indicators with automatic warm-up, all plotted: daily On-Balance Volume, a daily 20-period rate of change of price, and a 20-period rate of change of the OBV obtained by composing a RateOfChange onto the OBV indicator. Evaluation: every trading day 30 minutes after the open, once both rate-of-change indicators are ready. Divergence: bullish when price ROC is below zero and OBV ROC above zero; bearish when price ROC is above zero and OBV ROC below zero. State: increment the bullish streak and reset the bearish streak on a bullish day, the reverse on a bearish day; when neither, reset both streaks, liquidate any position and stop. Execution: bullish streak of 5 or more and not long, allocate 100% long; bearish streak of 5 or more and not short, allocate 100% short.
